name: The Nose Knows
body:
You know a perfume by its scent.

Prerequisite(s): Craft (perfume) 7 ranks

Benefit(s): You can determine the type and ingredients of any perfume that you can smell (Craft (alchemy) DC 20).

You can also use this check result to determine the perfume’s maker as if you had made a Diplomacy skill check to gather information about an individual.
